name: Rim Atmosphere
description: Presentation only (19i): the outer rim of the galaxy looks, sounds and reads colder, darker and lonelier — cold colour grading, dark dust lanes, grainy murk over unexplored rim systems, derelict hulks, eyes in the dark (small blinking red pairs) in rim systems, dimmer lights and a vignette deep in the rim; a sparse music mood and a wind/static ambient bed that grow with distance; bleaker rim system names and rim-flavoured message wording; rare garbled distress calls from rim outposts. No gameplay change.
